Odder is a Danish municipality included in the clinical quality analyses of the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses atrial fibrillation treatment quality across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Registry (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) to facilitate local benchmarking and quality development within the healthcare system [^src1].

Within this report, Odder's specific data regarding apoplexy (stroke) events among atrial fibrillation patients is utilized in the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulation (AC) treatment [^src1]. Odder's performance metrics for this indicator are detailed in a municipal breakdown on page 95, which lists specific statistical outputs, including event rates and confidence intervals [^src1]. Because the available corpus data for Odder is limited to this single tabular mention regarding municipal healthcare metrics, no further relationships, distinct claims, or chronological events are available.
